- At Level 4, as a built-in effect of reaching that level, Jeanne d’Arc’s companions are upgraded to Elite status. No manual upgrade action is described; it occurs through level progression.
- The Rally Call ability at Level 4 also produces additional units (companions/other units), but the Elite upgrade is specifically tied to the Level 4 milestone.

No further detail on upgrade mechanics (e.g., cost, research) is provided on this page.
